report.summary: tests/test_host_predicate.py: Pins the consolidated host-to-lane predicate (lane_for_host) with a comprehensive table of hosts, ensures all callers delegate to it, and prevents reintroduction of duplicate local-host tables.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_host_predicate.py|Tests pin both halves: the shared answers, and the absence of any caller-local copy.
SMELL|tests/test_host_predicate.py|High test count with many parametrized cases; possible maintenance burden but necessary for comprehensive coverage.
SMELL|tests/test_host_predicate.py|Uses _OWNED_ELSEWHERE allowlist that must be manually updated; if forgotten, test_no_caller_keeps_its_own_copy may miss new duplicates.
